# Test fixtures

`landscape.png` is a **generated** stand-in photograph — a drawn evening
landscape with a clear ridge and a sun to the right. It exists so the photo
features can be proved (colours read, horizon found, light placed, the photo
put through a style) without anybody's real photographs being committed to a
public repository.

Nothing in CODA PICS uploads a photo. This file is here for the tests, not for
the app.
